game.title: New England Patriots at Jacksonville Jaguars

lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play), while New England Patriots owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#8 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Jacksonville Jaguars -4.3 with a fair total of 44.3 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New England Patriots run offence vs Jacksonville Jaguars run defence, which sits +0.057 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
